name: Shenzhen BIQU Innovation Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Shenzhen printer and upgrade-parts brand (est. 2015), sister brand of mainboard maker BIGTREETECH, that has sold its own PLA since around 2021: PLA Matte, PLA Premium, 'GO' PLA and PLA-HR. The filament extruder is not identified.

product_lines.name: PLA-HR
product_lines.notes: Seen only on a desertcart listing; meaning of 'HR' not established, so no variant id asserted.

additional_notes: BIGTREETECH (Shenzhen Bigtree Technology, mainboards) is described by SimplyPrint as BIQU's sister brand; both names are recorded under brands on this one entry because BIGTREETECH has no separate filament line or catalog entry to point a sister-brand relationship at. No evidence of a filament OEM. biqu.equipment was rate-limited during research and not read directly. Price tier budget-mid, unverified, so omitted.

provenance.conflicts: Exact corporate tie between BIQU and BIGTREETECH (common ownership vs brand partnership) not verified from a registry. Filament manufacturer and manufacturing country unknown.
